name: Poland (since 1918)
summary: Poland reborn in 1918 after 123 years of partition: invaded in 1939, a communist state from 1945, and a democracy since Solidarity’s victory in 1989.

knownFor.label: Solidarity
knownFor.note: Trade union movement that helped end communism.

knownFor.label: Marie Curie
knownFor.note: Born in Warsaw; first woman to win a Nobel Prize.
